plum.description: Primary brand color. High authority, luxury Indian wine tone. AA+ contrast on cream/white.

plumHover.description: Hover and pressed state for primary plum buttons. Darkens 15%.

plumMuted.description: Disabled button state background or delicate decorative fill.

cream.description: Primary canvas and storefront background. Warm ivory, minimizes eye fatigue.

linen.description: Secondary surface, card background, input field default background.

white.description: Modal overlay background, elevated dropdown card surface.

gold.description: Antique Gold. STRICTLY DECORATIVE for borders, icons, and foil badges. NEVER use for body text.

goldDark.description: Deeper gold tone for fine lines and border contrast.

emerald.description: Deep emerald accent for trust badges, in-stock indicators, and bridal contrast.

crimson.description: Festival and silk thread ruby accent.

primary.description: Stone 900. High readability body text. Contrast 14.8:1 on cream (WCAG AAA).

secondary.description: Stone 600. Secondary metadata, category descriptions. Contrast 5.2:1 on cream (WCAG AA).

muted.description: Stone 500. Form placeholders, inactive tabs. Contrast 4.6:1 on cream (WCAG AA).

inverse.description: Text on primary plum or dark buttons.

success.description: Green 700. In-stock indicators, order confirmed, checkout success.

error.description: Red 700. Form validation error, payment failure, low stock alert.

warning.description: Amber 700. Sizing warning, delivery delay notices.
